mapper.select: select a.*, b.PROJECT_NAME as subContractName, b.CONTRACT_NO as subContractNo, b.COUNTERPARTY as subContractCounterparty, b.SECOND_LEVEL as subContractSecondLevel, b.SUB_TYPE as subContractType, b.EXPENSE_NATURE as subContractExpenseNature, b.EXPENSE_NATURE_MEMO as subContractExpenseNatureMemo, b.CONTRACT_AMOUNT as subContractAmount from BIZ_POR_SUB_SETTLE a left join BIZ_CRM_SUBCONTRACT b on a.SUB_HETONG_ID = b.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.*, b.PROJECT_NAME as subContractName, b.CONTRACT_NO as subContractNo, b.COUNTERPARTY as subContractCounterparty, b.SECOND_LEVEL as subContractSecondLevel, b.SUB_TYPE as subContractType, b.EXPENSE_NATURE as subContractExpenseNature, b.EXPENSE_NATURE_MEMO as subContractExpenseNatureMemo, b.CONTRACT_AMOUNT as subContractAmount from BIZ_POR_SUB_SETTLE a left join BIZ_CRM_SUBCONTRACT b on a.SUB_HETONG_ID = b.ID where a.ID = #{id}

select a.*, b.PROJECT_NAME as subContractName, b.CONTRACT_NO as subContractNo, b.COUNTERPARTY as subContractCounterparty, b.SECOND_LEVEL as subContractSecondLevel, b.SUB_TYPE as subContractType, b.EXPENSE_NATURE as subContractExpenseNature, b.EXPENSE_NATURE_MEMO as subContractExpenseNatureMemo, b.CONTRACT_AMOUNT as subContractAmount from BIZ_POR_SUB_SETTLE a join BIZ_CRM_SUBCONTRACT b on a.SUB_HETONG_ID = b.ID join BIZ_CRM_HETONG c on b.HETONG_ID = c.ID where c.BIZ_PROJECT_ID = #{bizProjectId} and c.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and c.STATUS in ('0','1') and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and b.STATUS in ('0','1') and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'
